title: Finiteness of a module is equivalent to injectivity of Hom into filtered colimits

standard_prerequisites.name: Description of a filtered colimit of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used in both halves of the counted proof (lines 1818-1820 and 1827-1830)
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets a vanishing condition be moved to some stage of the colimit.

standard_prerequisites.name: Generation of a submodule by a finite set
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the submodule N_E whose quotient is used to test the injectivity hypothesis.

core_obligations: Assume N is finite and take finitely many generators: if a map into a stage becomes zero after passing to the colimit, then each generator dies at some later stage, and a single stage works for all of them by finiteness (proof lines 1816-1823).

For the converse, form for each finite subset E of N the submodule it generates, so that the quotients N/N_E form a filtered colimit equal to zero, and apply the hypothesis to the identity of N to conclude that its image lies in some N_E (proof lines 1826-1830).
proof_roadmap: From finiteness, move the vanishing of finitely many generators to a common stage (proof lines 1815-1823).
From injectivity, use the colimit of quotients by finitely generated submodules to exhibit a finite generating set (proof lines 1824-1831).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises finiteness of a module N by the injectivity of the map from the filtered colimit of Hom(N, M_i) into Hom(N, M) for every filtered colimit presentation of every module M (statement lines 1805-1813). The proof does not use compactness in an arbitrary category: in one direction it moves the vanishing of each of finitely many generators to some stage and then takes a common later stage, and in the other it applies the hypothesis to the identity map of N and to the filtered colimit of the quotients by submodules generated by finite subsets, concluding that N is generated by one finite subset (proof lines 1815-1831). Deciding to test the hypothesis on the identity map is what produces the finite generating set. H2.
